WITH RECURSIVE comment_tree AS ( -- 基础查询：获取直接子评论 SELECT c.id as comment_id, c.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_avatar, cc.content as content, c.create_time as create_time, c.parent_id, 1 as level, parent_c.id as parent_comment_id, parent_ui.user_name as parent_user_name FROM comments c LEFT JOIN comment_content cc ON c.id = cc.comment_id LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON c.user_id = ui.user_id LEFT JOIN comments parent_c ON c.parent_id = parent_c.id LEFT JOIN user_info parent_ui ON parent_c.user_id = parent_ui.user_id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 0
UNION ALL
-- 递归查询：获取子评论的子评论 SELECT c2.id as comment_id, c2.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_avatar, cc.content as content, c2.create_time as create_time, c2.parent_id, ct.level + 1 as level, parent_c.id as parent_comment_id, parent_ui.user_name as parent_user_name FROM comments c2 INNER JOIN comment_tree ct ON c2.parent_id = ct.comment_id LEFT JOIN comment_content cc ON c2.id = cc.comment_id LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON c2.user_id = ui.user_id LEFT JOIN comments parent_c ON c2.parent_id = parent_c.id LEFT JOIN user_info parent_ui ON parent_c.user_id = parent_ui.user_id WHERE c2.status = 0 ) SELECT * FROM comment_tree ORDER BY level, comment_id
